results.title: Wyandotte County voters reject sales tax proposals as residents weigh needs, costs
results.description: Voters on Tuesday rejected two separate sales tax proposals: a countywide measure for health and homelessness services and a Kansas City, Kansas, measure for parks and infrastructure.
